Definition: probably from the same as G188; a thorn:--thorn.
BiblicalUsage: Thorns are the Bible's picture of the curse and of the world's opposition. You do not gather grapes from thorns, Jesus says; thorns choke the seed in the parable of the sower; and the soldiers plait a crown of thorns and press it on His head.
TheologicalSignificance: A thorn is a picture, not a doctrine, and the word carries little weight on its own; its weight is the crown, where the curse of Eden is gathered onto the head of the King.
RelatedEvents: The Crucifixion; The Parable of the Sower
